name: Body Fat Percentage
description: Percentage of body weight that is fat

name: Height
description: A measure of a person's stature or vertical length from head to foot while standing erect.

name: Hematocrit
description: Percentage of blood volume occupied by red blood cells

name: Hemoglobin
description: Oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells

name: MCV
description: Mean Corpuscular Volume — average red blood cell size

name: Steps
description: Number of steps taken, typically measured over a 24-hour period using a pedometer or accelerometer device.

name: T-Score
description: Standard deviations from peak bone mass

name: Waist-Hip Ratio
description: Waist circumference divided by hip circumference
